injuries.longComment: Nivar will hit the inactive list in an effort to preserve her eligibility under a developmental deal. Her next opportunity to suit up will come Monday against the Tempo.
injuries.shortComment: Nivar (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Washington.

injuries.longComment: Paopao has already missed the last two games with a right leg injury and can be considered week-to-week moving forward. In the meantime, Isobel Borlase will likely see a bump in minutes off the bench.
injuries.shortComment: Paopao (leg) will be re-evaluated in "the coming weeks," WNBA reporter Kareem Copeland reports.

injuries.longComment: Taylor will miss a second consecutive contest with a left groin injury, and her next opportunity to play will come Monday against Seattle. With the rookie guard sidelined, Jacy Sheldon and Gabriela Jaquez are candidates for increased playing time.
injuries.shortComment: Taylor (groin) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Fever, Chicago State of Mind Sports reports.

injuries.longComment: Diggins hasn't played since July 3 due to a right knee injury and remains without a clear timetable for a return. The veteran guard can be considered week-to-week until the Sky provide an update on her progress.
injuries.shortComment: Diggins (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Mercury.

injuries.longComment: The season-ending knee injury is a devastating development for Jackson and the Sky, as the 25-year-old forward was well on her way to a career-best campaign. Through Chicago's first four games, Jackson averaged 18.0 points, 4.8 rebounds, 2.0 assists, 1.8 blocks and 1.5 three-pointers in 29.5 minutes per contest. After Jackson's early exit in Sunday's contest, Aicha Coulibaly opened the second half with the starters and looks to be the most likely candidate to move into the top unit for the Sky's next game Wednesday versus the Wings.
injuries.shortComment: The Sky announced Tuesday that Jackson will miss the remainder of the season after suffering a torn ACL in her left knee during Sunday's 86-79 win over the Lynx.

injuries.longComment: Jackson will be held out of Friday's contest after logging 11 minutes in Sunday's loss to Dallas, when she recorded one assist. Her next opportunity to play will come Thursday against the Dream.
injuries.shortComment: Jackson (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mercury.

injuries.longComment: Beers is in the league's concussion protocol for at least one game. Nell Angloma figures to step into the backup center role behind Brittney Griner (knee), if she's available, or Olivia Nelson-Ododa.
injuries.shortComment: Beers is out for Friday's game against Phoenix with a concussion.

injuries.longComment: Kliundikova joined the Lynx for the 2025 campaign and was selected by the Tempo in the second round of the WNBA Expansion Draft ahead of the 2026 season. However, she's been playing overseas and that's where she's expected to remain for the remainder of the campaign.
injuries.shortComment: The Tempo traded Kliundikova's (not injury related) rights along with a second-round pick to the Sun in exchange for Aneesah Morrow, Myles Ehrlich of Winsidr.com reports.

injuries.longComment: Fudd wasn't listed on the injury report throughout most of the day. However, after experiencing soreness during pregame warmups, the team will take the cautious approach and keep her out. Without Fudd, Aziaha James will enter the starting lineup for the first time since the 84-83 loss to Portland on June 13, a game which she finished with 17 points, six rebounds, four assists and two steals across 34 minutes.
injuries.shortComment: Fudd (knee) is listed as out for Friday's game versus Golden State.

injuries.longComment: Clark will now miss her second consecutive contest, with her next opportunity to get back on the court coming Sunday versus Minnesota. Since Clark hasn't seen consistent action of late, her absence won't significantly impact the rotation, though it could still allow Li Yueru and Awak Kuier to receive more playing time.
injuries.shortComment: Clark (back) is listed as out for Friday's game versus the Valkyries.

injuries.longComment: Sowah is signed to a developmental contract and limited to 12 regular-season appearances. She hasn't played in over two months, and her next opportunity to suit up will come Sunday versus the Sparks.
injuries.shortComment: Sowah (coach's decision) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Wings.

injuries.longComment: Prechtel will sit out Friday's contest in an effort to preserve her eligibility while signed to a developmental pact. Her next opportunity to play will come Sunday in Los Angeles.
injuries.shortComment: Prechtel (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Wings.

injuries.longComment: Rupert signed a multi-year contract with Golden State during the offseason and missed the start of training camp due to an overseas commitment. Her status for the 2026 regular season now appears to be in jeopardy due to her pregnancy. The 24-year-old made 21 regular-season appearances (11 starts) for the Valkyries last year and averaged 9.3 points, 3.9 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 23.1 minutes per game. If Rupert is sidelined in 2026, Janelle Salaun, Kiah Stokes and Laeticia Amihere are candidates to see increased work.
injuries.shortComment: Rupert is pregnant, and the Valkyries have filed for a replacement contract ahead of the 2026 season, Alexa Philippou of ESPN.com reports Thursday.

injuries.longComment: Boston has been a mainstay on the injury report recently due to a lingering lower-leg injury, though she's expected to suit up for Saturday's road game. The star center is coming off a 21-point, 12-rebound double-double and has averaged 16.6 points, 7.4 rebounds, 4.2 assists and 3.2 combined steals-plus-blocks across 26.4 minutes per game in her last five appearances.
injuries.shortComment: Boston (lower leg) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against the Sky.

injuries.longComment: Clark has been a fixture on the injury report for the Fever, but she hasn't missed a game since July 9 in Phoenix. The 38 minutes she played during Thursday's overtime loss to the Aces were the superstar guard's most since the June 11 win over the Sky, suggesting Clark isn't facing any workload restrictions at this time.
injuries.shortComment: Clark (back) is probable for Saturday's game against the Sky.

injuries.longComment: Dantas struggled to stay healthy and will go ahead and address her knee issues now rather than delaying any longer. She made 12 appearances this season, posting averages of 3.3 points and 1.5 rebounds in 8.2 minutes per contest.
injuries.shortComment: Dantas underwent left knee surgery Tuesday and will miss the remainder of the 2026 season, the Fever announced.

injuries.longComment: Pissott will be held out of the front end of this back-to-back set due to a right leg injury. She can be considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Liberty until the Aces offer an update on her status.
injuries.shortComment: Pissott (leg) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Lynx.

injuries.longComment: Parker-Tyus will miss a sixth consecutive contest with a concussion and is still away from the team, so she can presumably be ruled out for the second leg of this back-to-back set. With the veteran forward out, Brianna Turner will likely continue to see a slight bump in playing time.
injuries.shortComment: Parker-Tyus (concussion/not with team) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Lynx.

injuries.longComment: Pili will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set in an effort to preserve her eligibility under a developmental contract. She hasn't seen game action since the July 13 loss to Atlanta, and her next opportunity to play will come Sunday against the Valkyries.
injuries.shortComment: Pili (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

injuries.longComment: out
injuries.shortComment: out

injuries.longComment: King is eligible to suit up for 12 regular-season games while signed to a developmental contract. The 24-year-old has not played since the 96-87 win over the Sparks on July 15, and her next opportunity to get back on the floor will come Sunday versus Dallas, the second of back-to-back outings for the Lynx.
injuries.shortComment: King (coach's decision) is listed as out for Saturday's game versus Las Vegas.

injuries.longComment: Bibby is still waiting to make her Lynx debut. Her next chance to do so comes during the second half of Minnesota's back-to-back Sunday against the Wings.
injuries.shortComment: Bibby (personal) is out for Saturday's game against the Aces.

injuries.longComment: out
injuries.shortComment: out

injuries.longComment: Maley avoided the initial injury report but ultimately won't play Wednesday as New York preserves her eligibility while on a developmental contract. The forward's next chance to suit up will come Sunday against Las Vegas.
injuries.shortComment: Maley (coach's decision) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Seattle.

injuries.longComment: Fiebich has been sidelined since July 7 and was only recently cleared for individual work. Her next chance to play comes August 9 against the Aces.
injuries.shortComment: Fiebich (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Storm, Myles Ehrlich of Winsidr.com reports.

injuries.longComment: As a developmental player, Ciezki is permitted to suit up for 12 regular-season contests. She has played only twice during the 2026 campaign, most recently logging eight minutes in the 89-80 victory over Toronto on June 27. Her next opportunity to get on the floor will come Sunday against Washington.
injuries.shortComment: Ciezki (coach's decision) is listed as out for Friday's game versus Connecticut.

injuries.longComment: Dunn will hit the inactive list Friday as the Mercury manage her eligibility under a developmental contract. Her next opportunity to play will come Sunday in Washington.
injuries.shortComment: Dunn (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Sun.

injuries.longComment: Nogic had her contract temporarily suspended June 20 and will now be out for the remainder of the WNBA season, as she's slated to compete overseas in Russia with an eye on leading the Serbian national team in the EuroBasket 2027 qualifiers. The guard appeared in 16 games (seven starts) for Phoenix, averaging 10.4 points, 1.6 assists and 1.1 rebounds in 20.2 minutes per contest. With Nogic out of the fold for the foreseeable future, Alexa Held stands to continue benefiting from expanded opportunities in the backcourt.
injuries.shortComment: Nogic (not injury related) intends to play professionally in Russia and won't return to Phoenix this season, Aya Abdeen of TheIXSports.com reports.

injuries.longComment: Carleton continues to battle a foot injury, though it hasn't kept her off the floor. The 29-year-old has been on a roll recently, recording a double-double in her last two contests. She has also scored at least 24 points in two of her previous three appearances.
injuries.shortComment: Carleton (foot) is listed as probable for Saturday's game versus Seattle.

injuries.longComment: Oblak is expected to return from a one-game absence due to a left knee injury, and her return would leave fewer minutes available for Jordan Harrison and Holly Winterburn. Oblak has averaged 5.0 points, 2.0 assists, 1.0 rebounds and 0.8 steals in 11.2 minutes per game over her last five appearances.
injuries.shortComment: Oblak (knee) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against the Storm.

injuries.longComment: Barker was helped to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's loss to the Wings, and she's now been diagnosed with a season-ending injury. The second-year guard took on a significant role for the Fire after the club selected her in the 2026 WNBA Expansion Draft. Across 26 regular-season games (15 starts), the 24-year-old averaged 10.7 points, 4.5 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 0.9 steals in 24.7 minutes per contest. Karlie Samuelson, Teja Oblak and Nyadiew Puoch are candidates for increased playing time in Barker's stead.
injuries.shortComment: The Fire announced Friday that Barker will undergo surgery to repair a torn ACL and will miss the remainder of the 2026 campaign.

injuries.longComment: Feagin agreed to a developmental contract with Portland on June 24 after spending time in Los Angeles. After appearing in 16 regular-season games for the Sparks in 2025, the 23-year-old played in only three regular-season contests in 2026, logging a combined 10 minutes. Feagin had yet to make her debut with the Fire, though that will now need to wait, assuming Portland keeps her on the roster moving ahead.
injuries.shortComment: Feagin (knee) was diagnosed with a torn left ACL on Thursday and will miss the rest of the 2026 campaign, WNBA reporter Kareem Copeland reports.

injuries.longComment: Samuelson exited Wednesday's 92-86 loss to the Liberty and didn't return. Now, she is in danger of missing her first game since May. If Samuelson can't suit up Saturday versus the Fire, it could mean more minutes for Zia Cooke and Jordan Horston. Mackenzie Holmes and Taylor Thierry may also get involved after playing sparingly all season.
injuries.shortComment: Samuelson (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Portland.

injuries.longComment: Mair has appeared in four regular-season games in 2026 and will remain on the inactive list Saturday as the Storm manage her eligibility under a developmental contract. The rookie's next chance to play will come Monday against the Sky.
injuries.shortComment: Mair (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Portland.

injuries.longComment: Bankole will be held out of Thursday's contest to preserve her eligibility while signed to a developmental contract. Her next opportunity to play will come in Atlanta on Monday.
injuries.shortComment: Bankole (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Portland.

injuries.longComment: Sykes has been sidelined since June 16 due to a plantar fascia injury and has recently taken part in individual activities during practice, but it seems the veteran is still a long way from returning to game action. Her extended absence has been notable for the Tempo, as Sykes averaged 20.1 points, 3.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 1.3 steals in 15 contests before being hampered by injury.
injuries.shortComment: Tempo head coach Sandy Brondello indicated Sunday that Sykes (foot) isn't close to returning to game action, Ian Finlayson of Sportsnet reports.
